title: Quadratic Inequalities
seo_title: Grade 11 Quadratic Inequalities Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve quadratic inequalities in one unknown (interpret solutions graphically).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 quadratic inequalities worksheets: solving from factors and trinomials, with a sketch of the parabola. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Make one side 0 and factorise to find the critical values.
  • For a ∪ parabola: < 0 between the roots, > 0 outside the roots.
  • If the x² term is negative, multiply by −1 and reverse the sign.
  • ≤ and ≥ include the roots.

Examples

Example

x² − x − 6 < 0

(x − 3)(x + 2) < 0

Answer: −2 < x < 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Only the rootsThe answer is an interval.
Between or outside> 0 is outside for ∪.
−x²Multiply by −1 and flip the sign.
